system.description: The torpedo shark ( Portheus velocis ) is the Awakened variant of the blue shark that can be found in the tropical and subtropical waters of the Pacific Ocean at depths no greater than 150 meters. It grows to five meters long and up to 1,000 kilograms. Its domed head is heavily armored by bony calcifications that give the shark a torpedo-like appearance. The shark's eyes and jaw are set behind and protected by the large brow ridge. A torpedo shark is also unusual in its lack 157 a dorsal fin. Coloration can vary from black to pale blue-grey.
